summary: Taos County peak with a Forest Service fire lookout station by 1914 (per a 1914 Albuquerque Journal account); FFLA lists it as a gone rock shelter; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Albuquerque Journal account of August 19, 1914, quoted by Forest Lookouts, describes a Forest Service fire lookout station on Jicarita Peak

notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: one 1914 newspaper account, quoted on a hobby lookout site, plus the FFLA listing. No build date, no end date and no description of remains exist in the sources read, so there is no built or fate event beyond the 1914 mention. Kind is ground-level rock shelter per FFLA, not a tower, and the record's ground kind fits. Access is inferred from a SummitPost route guide. The story's last paragraph states that no source describes the summit today; an editor may want a site photo or a Carson NF check before publishing.
